page.overview:
Who is Danelle?

She had big blue eyes and was dreamy, with few friends even in her own Ajah. She was 5'5 and slight of build. Mesaana also bore a passing resemblance to her, enough that only a little Illusion was needed for Mesaana to impersonate her.

Danelle was strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . Mesaana would have used an unknown weave to appear to be the same strength as Danelle to avoid suspicion, Messaana's true strength being almost as strong as it's possible for a woman to be.

Born in , she went to the White Tower in . Spending nine years as a novice and seven as Accepted, she was raised in . She would have progressed faster had she not always been going off into a dream. She spent much time in introspection and could drift off while talking to someone.

Danelle spent a lot of time out of the Tower - in fact, as soon as she gained the shawl she left - and had no close friends as she was always lost in thought or books. She was seldom in the Tower for more than a few months at a time, and at widely-spaced intervals. This meant she was quite unknown, and Mesaana took advantage of that to impersonate her. She also never had a Warder, which helped.
